rules.title: San Francisco Security Deposit Interest Rate
rules.requirement: Landlords in San Francisco must pay tenants annual interest on security deposits at the rate set by the Rent Board for each one-year period.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential rental units covered by the San Francisco Rent Ordinance (units subject to Rent Board jurisdiction).
rules.citation: S.F. Admin. Code § 37.9 (Rent Board Security Deposit Interest Rate)
rules.quoted_span:
Security Deposit Interest:
4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is subject to the San Francisco Rent Ordinance (Rent Board jurisdiction)
